description: Setup: typed Movies/TV Shows search with a catalog-linked title selected. Hold each title for two seconds: cast appears first, similar titles below; all ancestor rows remain. No acquisition actions.

steps.name: 01-context-enter
steps.review: Parent result remains above cast and similar titles. No page promotion, jump to top, or keyboard overlay.

steps.name: 02-context-next-tier
steps.review: Hold an actor or related title two seconds: append its child shelves, preserving the root and its cast/similar siblings.

steps.name: 03-context-parent
steps.review: Back focuses the parent card without collapsing the branch; Down can revisit it.

steps.name: 04-context-sibling
steps.review: Moving to a sibling preserves old descendants during the two-second dwell; afterward only that sibling branch is replaced. Root and current rows stay fixed.
